sections.Profile:
Demolition Man , released by Williams in February 1994, is a four-player widebody machine based on the film, in which the player chases after and defeats Simon Phoenix in the future. Designed by Dennis Nordman, it has three ramps, a Cryo Claw the player steers to drop the ball onto one of five awards, and upright handles whose trigger buttons work the flippers.
